items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is listed as doubtful for Sunday’s game vs. the Saints.
items.implication: High likelihood of missing; downgrade significantly or sit.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining BAL WRs and TE Mark Andrews (25% tgt share already with absences).

items.text: Raiders listing TE Brock Bowers as doubtful for Sunday vs. Chargers due to knee injury, per HC Klint Kubiak; returned to practice Friday, expected back Week 3.
items.why: Knee; HC notes day-to-day but doubtful designation.
items.implication: Sit for Week 2; Michael Mayer remains lead TE/viable starter.
items.opportunity: Full TE1 usage for Mayer one more week.

items.text: Bengals listing QB Joe Burrow, who said he would play, as questionable for Sunday at Houston due to back injury.
items.why: Back injury; self-reported will play but official Q tag.
items.implication: Monitor closely; CIN skill players (Chase/Higgins/Brown) risk if limited or out.

items.text: Vikings ruled out QB Kyler Murray for Sunday vs. Bears (concussion); Carson Wentz starts.
items.implication: Wentz start boosts Justin Jefferson volume (37% share W1 with him).
items.opportunity: Jefferson high target share continues; Wentz streamer.

items.text: Falcons ruled out QB Michael Penix Jr. for Sunday vs. Panthers; Cooper Rush expected to start.
items.why: Knee; not ready, Rush taking first-team reps.
items.implication: ATL skill (Bijan/London/Pitts) face lower ceiling with backup QB.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson is set to make his debut on Sunday (missed W1 ankle).
items.why: Ankle; full practice, self-reported ready; Rapoport/GMFB confirmation.
items.implication: Role expansion vs Stevenson; monitor split but ready for significant work.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes vs Rhamondre Stevenson; Brown IR opens path.

items.text: For the second straight day, Chargers WR Ladd McConkey did not practice due to rib injury, making it unlikely he will be available Sunday vs. Raiders.
items.why: Rib/chest; consecutive DNPs; day-to-day but low practice participation.
items.implication: Prepare to sit; Quentin Johnston and others see route/target boost.
items.opportunity: Johnston/Tre Harris elevated routes (90%+ without him in W1 late).

items.text: If Zay Flowers (hamstring, multi-DNP) can't go (Lane already IR/return), Ravens WRs hierarchy: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester 4. Elijah Sarratt 5. Chris Moore.
items.why: Clear depth chart projection on absence; Bateman primary beneficiary.
items.implication: Bateman flex viable; Andrews already elevated.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring Wednesday practice (Houston Chronicle); missed 5 games on hammy in 2024. Crucial MRI. W1 routes on 42 Stroud dropbacks: Collins 37, Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27, Noel 15.
items.why: Heavy route share (37/42) + hamstring history puts Week 2 in jeopardy pre-OUT confirmation.
items.implication: Fantasy sit even pre-final; beneficiaries clear on volume.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: handled 21 of 24 team RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), targeted 40% of routes (team lead). IND just gave up 163 yds/3 TD to Henry.
items.why: Elite W1 utilization + soft matchup vs run defense that allowed big day to Henry.
items.opportunity: High snap/touch/target share confirmed; goal-line implied.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score W1 (tied Bijan league lead). 19% target share last 10 games; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.implication: Strong RB start with receiving upside.

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz W1; averages 93 yds/18.0 PPG in 6 career games with Wentz. Bears D allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.why: Proven chemistry with Wentz + soft secondary matchup; Murray OUT locks Wentz.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Kendre Miller rush attempts W1, 69% fantasy pts through air. Kamara expected back squeezes role further; NO 8.5-pt underdogs bad rush script.
items.why: Split backfield + pass-game reliance + Kamara return + tough script/matchup.
items.opportunity: Kendre Miller more viable if Kamara limited.
